blocks.html: Glass installed as floors, landings, stairs and in similar locations shall be designed and engineered by a registered design professional and the design shall include the applicable provisions of ASTM E 2751 and the load requirements of Chapter 16. Such assemblies shall comply with the fire-resistance rating and marking requirements of this code where applicable.
